extracted.intended_audience: patent researchers, historians, and people looking up 1878 US patent bibliographic records (patentees, invention titles, dates, patent numbers, Gazette references)
extracted.subtask_description: Alphabetical index of patentees and their inventions for U.S. patents issued in 1878, listing patent numbers, invention titles, dates, monthly volume, and Official Gazette references. Useful as a bibliographic lookup/reference for historical patent research.
